{{Quote|There are citizens loyal to the Empire on every planet in this galaxy. They are already getting sick of this New Republic and its rules and regulations.|The warlord|<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />}}
An '''individual''' was a [[warlord]] and a member of the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]]. The warlord believed that throughout the galaxy, there existed many citizens loyal to the former [[Galactic Empire]] on every [[planet]], and that such citizens were getting tired of the [[New Republic]] and its rules and regulations, which she expressed to the council in a meeting, to the agreement of [[Unidentified Imperial warlord 2|another]], who suggested that the Shadow Council should rally such loyalists behind them against the Republic through an open show of force.<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The warlord first appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' which was released on [[April 12]], [[2023]].<ref name="S3 Dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}}</ref> The warlord was portrayed by [[Jodi Long]].<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />
